Name: Shattering Smite
Description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell’s duration, your weapon is enveloped by your very own aura, causing it to ripple against any surface—creating cracks and fissures with ease. On your next hit you deal an additional 2d4 thunder damage and apply 2 Rupture counts.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the thunder damage dealt by the attack increases by 1d4, and you deal an additional Rupture count for each slot level above 1st.
